{{Top|leg}}
During the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] organized some of his [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] into formations he called a '''roving fleet'''. One such [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], consisting of a [[Lancer-class frigate/Legends|''Lancer''-class frigate]], [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]], and an [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|''Ton-Falk''-class escort carrier]], [[Battle of Galtea|engaged]] the New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[FarStar]]'' above [[Galtea/Legends|Galtea]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].
